beats.line: Tired of the daily traffic struggle in your city?
Unpredictable commutes steal your time and energy every single day.
Glide past it all on the dependable Radboards KingSong 14D.
Reach 30 km/h with a 35 km range and carry its 14.5 kg easily.
Get the KingSong 14D for ₹75,000 at Radboards.in. Range and speed vary.
